nodes.name: Film
nodes.description: The art of the motion picture, combining moving images, sound, and narrative or experimental form.

nodes.name: Film Genres
nodes.description: Categories of film defined by shared narrative conventions, mood, and subject matter.

nodes.name: Drama Film
nodes.description: Film centered on serious, realistic characters and emotional conflict.

nodes.name: Comedy Film
nodes.description: Film designed to provoke laughter.

nodes.name: Action Film
nodes.description: Film driven by physical feats, stunts, and combat.

nodes.name: Adventure Film
nodes.description: Film of quests, exotic journeys, and heroic escapades.

nodes.name: Thriller Film
nodes.description: Film engineered for suspense and tension.

nodes.name: Horror Film
nodes.description: Film designed to frighten and unsettle.

nodes.name: Science Fiction Film
nodes.description: Film exploring speculative science, technology, and futures.

nodes.name: Fantasy Film
nodes.description: Film of magic, myth, and imaginary worlds.

nodes.name: Romance Film
nodes.description: Film centered on romantic love.

nodes.name: Western Film
nodes.description: Film set in the American frontier, mythologizing the Old West.

nodes.name: Film Noir
nodes.description: Stylized crime films of moral ambiguity and shadowy cinematography.

nodes.name: Crime Film
nodes.description: Film about crime, criminals, and law enforcement.

nodes.name: War Film
nodes.description: Film depicting armed conflict and its effects.

nodes.name: Musical Film
nodes.description: Film integrating song and dance into the narrative.

nodes.name: Documentary Film
nodes.description: Nonfiction film recording reality for information and persuasion.

nodes.name: Mystery Film
nodes.description: Film centered on solving an enigma or crime.

nodes.name: Historical Film
nodes.description: Film reconstructing a past era or event.

nodes.name: Sports Film
nodes.description: Film centered on athletics and competition.

nodes.name: Biographical Film
nodes.description: Film dramatizing the life of a real person.

nodes.name: Coming-of-Age Film
nodes.description: Film about a protagonist's transition from youth to adulthood.

nodes.name: Martial Arts Film
nodes.description: Film showcasing hand-to-hand combat and martial arts.

nodes.name: Wuxia Film
nodes.description: Chinese film of chivalrous martial heroes and swordplay fantasy.

nodes.name: Jidaigeki
nodes.description: Japanese period film set in the Edo era or earlier, often featuring samurai.

nodes.name: Bollywood Musical
nodes.description: Hindi popular cinema built on song, dance, and melodrama.

nodes.name: Film Movements
nodes.description: Historical schools and styles of filmmaking.

nodes.name: German Expressionism
nodes.description: 1920s German cinema of distorted sets and shadows.

nodes.name: Soviet Montage
nodes.description: 1920s Soviet cinema built on dynamic editing theory.

nodes.name: Italian Neorealism
nodes.description: Postwar Italian cinema of nonprofessional actors and real locations.

nodes.name: French New Wave
nodes.description: Late 1950s-60s French cinema of handheld cameras and auteur style.

nodes.name: Cinema Verite
nodes.description: Documentary style of observational truth-seeking with handheld cameras.

nodes.name: Direct Cinema
nodes.description: North American observational documentary avoiding intervention.

nodes.name: New Hollywood
nodes.description: Late 1960s-70s American cinema of director-driven, edgy films.

nodes.name: Dogme 95
nodes.description: 1990s Danish movement of austere, rule-bound filmmaking.

nodes.name: New German Cinema
nodes.description: 1960s-80s West German auteur cinema.

nodes.name: Third Cinema
nodes.description: Political cinema of the Global South opposing colonial and Hollywood models.

nodes.name: Film Forms
nodes.description: Formats and lengths of motion pictures.

nodes.name: Feature Film
nodes.description: A full-length narrative film, typically over an hour.

nodes.name: Short Film
nodes.description: A brief film under feature length.

nodes.name: Silent Film
nodes.description: Film without synchronized sound, dominant before the late 1920s.

nodes.name: Experimental Film
nodes.description: Avant-garde film challenging narrative and technical conventions.

nodes.name: Newsreel
nodes.description: Short news films shown in cinemas, now obsolete.

nodes.name: Cinematography
nodes.description: The art of capturing film through camera work and lighting.

nodes.name: Film Editing
nodes.description: The selection and arrangement of shots to shape rhythm and meaning.

nodes.name: Screenwriting
nodes.description: The craft of writing scripts for film.

nodes.name: Film Directing
nodes.description: The creative oversight of a film's realization and performance.

nodes.name: Production Design
nodes.description: The design of a film's visual world through sets, props, and locations.

nodes.name: Film Scoring
nodes.description: The composition of music to accompany a film.

nodes.name: Film Sound Design
nodes.description: The creation of a film's sonic environment and effects.

nodes.name: Storyboarding
nodes.description: Sequential sketches planning a film's shots and action.

nodes.name: Color Grading
nodes.description: The adjustment of color and tone to create a film's look.

nodes.name: Film Lighting
nodes.description: The use of light to shape mood, depth, and subject in cinema.
